# vastdata_supported_drivers (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vastdata_supported_drivers" "example" {
  model_name = "ExampleModel"
  version    = "1.0.0"
  replace    = false

  drives = [
    {
      name        = "SSD_MODEL_X"
      type        = "SSD"
      model       = "ModelX"
      capacity_tb = 15
      hw_platform = ["platform-a", "platform-b"]

      fw = [
        {
          name   = "FW_1.0.0"
          latest = true
        }
      ]
    }
  ]

  platforms = [
    {
      name                   = "platform-a"
      ssd_capacity_tb        = 15
      default_section_layout = "default"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `model_name` (String) Model name for the supported driver

### Optional

- `drives` (Attributes Set) List of supported drives (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--drives))
- `platforms` (Attributes Set) List of supported hw platforms (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--platforms))
- `replace` (Boolean) Remove drives not present in data
- `signature` (String) Signature, base64-encoded
- `version` (String) Version

### Read-Only

- `created` (Number)
